title: WenHai-E2E: end-to-end machine learning for global eddy-resolving ocean forecasts
summary: WenHai-E2E produces global eddy-resolving ocean forecasts directly from multisource ocean observations, without initial conditions from a numerical forecast system. The authors state it outperforms a state-of-the-art numerical ocean forecast system (GOFS) in forecast accuracy; the abstract gives no numeric metrics. The full text was not accessible, so limits are not stated in the reviewed material.
ai_technology: WenHai-E2E (end-to-end deep learning ocean forecast model)
organization: Laoshan Laboratory; Ocean University of China; Shandong University; Qingdao Guoshi Technology Group

evidence.tested: Forecast accuracy compared against a state-of-the-art numerical global ocean forecast system (GOFS), as stated in the abstract.
evidence.unknown: Not stated in the reviewed material
evidence.ai_role: Machine learning model produces the full eddy-resolving global ocean forecast from observations, replacing numerical initial conditions.
